vc_checking.summary: All 36 current manual witnesses are semantically derivable from the frozen annotation and case_lib seed. Query/error witnesses unfold existing predicates; Read call-normalization uses result definitions; copy setup uses the existing initialized-slice lemmas; successful returns instantiate the FIFO post-state and use the existing consume-logical-state lemma. No annotation/spec rework is indicated.
